app_tagline: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_voice_subtitle: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Speak. We'll ask, you answer.
mode_text_badge: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_education: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] How far did you study?
q_disability: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
why_asked: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Why do we ask this?
caste_why: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] I already understand, skip to documents
talk_to_helper: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Connect with a Human Helper
physical_office_address: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [سنڌي / सिन्धी] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [sd] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [sd] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [sd] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [sd] Type or speak your question for the helper...
